Detail: Long-wearing matte lipstick. Apply from the centre of the lip outward; blot and reapply for deeper colour. Remove with an oil-based cleanser.
Leave-in serum for damaged ends. Use 2-3 drops on towel-dried hair, avoiding the scalp. Safe for colour-treated hair.
Latex-free clear adhesive for strip lashes. Wait 30 seconds after applying until the glue turns tacky, then place the lash along the lash line.
